source: prior-2025.json raw off_ppg / def_ppg (FOX Sports 2025 REG scoring). No 2026 forecasts.
formula_note: First term is the home offense vs away defense scoring environment; second is away offense vs home defense. Average of the two sides, then weather. ppg are 2025 regular-season raw stats already on disk in prior-2025.json (teams.*.raw). Do not seed Week 1 2026 totals from a market number in August.

hfa.note: HFA is already in the spread. It is not added again to the total.

wx_total.note: 0 or negative. Dome or closed roof = 0. See weather-scale.json.

worked_example: our_total = 0.5*(home.off_ppg + away.def_ppg) + 0.5*(away.off_ppg + home.def_ppg) + 0.0 + wx_total. League mean of that expression with wx=0 is 46.0281 (mean 2025 off_ppg + mean 2025 def_ppg across 32 clubs).
